name: EyeTubeBot
headline: EyeTubeBot - Access Restricted Social Media Content
short_description: Product's purpose in the hand of the User will Grant ability to access all internet and Social Media content and files by bypassing all Restrictions & Limits. Not only that, but also we promise a level of Digital Creativity...
author: Mickekofi

sections.overview:
EyeTubeBot is a Telegram-based bot that automates downloading of videos, audio, images, and metadata from major social media platforms including YouTube, Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and Snapchat. It extracts detailed information from video uploads such as titles, descriptions, view counts, and thumbnails. The bot also provides website intelligence capabilities, retrieving ownership details, creation dates, connected links, security status, and embedded media from target websites. Available as both an open-source tool for developers and a commercial product for end-users, it serves content creators, researchers, and marketers who need to efficiently process and analyze internet content at scale.
Download high-quality videos from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms
Extract audio tracks from YouTube videos
Retrieve video metadata including title, description, views, and thumbnails
Gather website intelligence including ownership, creation date, keywords, and security details
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Mickekofi/EyeTubeBot`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a comprehensive list of [NUMBER] trending TikTok video ideas for [TARGET_AUDIENCE] in the [INDUSTRY/NICHE] space. Include viral hooks, suggested captions, and hashtags optimized for the [PLATFORM] algorithm. Ensure the ideas align with current trends and leverage [SPECIFIC_TREND_OR_TOOL] where applicable.
```
Copy

```
Here are 10 trending TikTok video ideas for a fitness influencer targeting Gen Z in the home workout niche, optimized for the July 2024 algorithm:

1. **"5-Minute No-Equipment HIIT Challenge"**
   - Hook: "Burn 500+ calories in 5 mins—no gym needed! 🔥"
   - Caption: "Tag a friend who needs this! #HomeWorkout #HIIT #NoEquipment"
   - Hashtags: #FitnessTok #BurnCalories #GenZFitness #QuickWorkout
   - Trend Leveraged: "5-minute challenge" trend + "no gym" hook

2. **"Get Abs in 30 Days (Day 1-30 Transformation)"**
   - Hook: "I did this for 30 days—here’s the proof! 💪"
   - Caption: "Follow my daily routine in the comments! #AbsChallenge #30DayChallenge"
   - Hashtags: #TransformationTuesday #FitnessJourney #SixPackAbs
   - Trend Leveraged: "30-day transformation" trend + before/after format

3. **"POV: You’re a Gym Bro Who Just Discovered TikTok Fitness"**
   - Hook: "When you realize TikTok has better workouts than your gym 😂"
   - Caption: "Switch to TikTok fitness—trust me. #GymTok #FitnessHumor"
   - Hashtags: #FunnyFitness #GymBro #TikTokFitness
   - Trend Leveraged: "POV” trend + gym humor

4. **"Budget vs. Luxury Gym Membership: Where’s the Value?"**
   - Hook: "$20/month vs. $100/month gym—what’s the difference? 🤔"
   - Caption: "Comment your gym membership cost! #GymHacks #BudgetFitness"
   - Hashtags: #GymTok #FitnessHacks #MoneySaving
   - Trend Leveraged: "budget vs. luxury” comparison trend

5. **"Reacting to Viral Fitness Trends (That Are Actually Dangerous)"**
   - Hook: "I tried the ‘100 squats a day’ trend—here’s what happened 😬"
   - Caption: "Don’t do this! #FitnessSafety #ViralTrends"
   - Hashtags: #FitnessReaction #TrendCheck #StaySafe
   - Trend Leveraged: "dangerous trends” reaction format

6. **"My Morning Routine to Stay Fit (No Gym Required)"**
   - Hook: "How I stay in shape without leaving my house 🏡"
   - Caption: "Drop your routine below! #MorningRoutine #HomeFitness"
   - Hashtags: #DailyRoutine #FitnessTips #NoGym
   - Trend Leveraged: "morning routine” trend + home fitness angle

7. **"Guess My Age Based on My Fitness Level"**
   - Hook: "Can you guess how old I am by my fitness? 🤯"
   - Caption: "Comment your guess! #FitnessAge #GuessTheAge"
   - Hashtags: #FitnessChallenge #FunnyFitness #AgeGuess
   - Trend Leveraged: "guess my age” interactive trend

8. **"The Worst Fitness Advice I’ve Ever Heard (And What to Do Instead)"**
   - Hook: "‘No pain, no gain’ is a lie—here’s why 🚫"
   - Caption: "What’s the worst fitness advice you’ve heard? #FitnessMyths"
   - Hashtags: #FitnessTruths #Debunked #HealthyHabits
   - Trend Leveraged: "myth-busting” trend

9. **"Satisfying ASMR: Cleaning My Gym Equipment"**
   - Hook: "The sound of a freshly wiped dumbbell… 😌"
   - Caption: "Who else loves gym ASMR? #ASMR #GymSounds"
   - Hashtags: #Satisfying #GymTok #CleanGym
   - Trend Leveraged: "satisfying ASMR” trend

10. **"How I Stay Motivated to Work Out Every Day"**
    - Hook: "My secret to 365 days of fitness 💯"
    - Caption: "What’s your motivation? #FitnessMotivation #DailyWorkout"
    - Hashtags: #Consistency #FitnessJourney #MotivationMonday
    - Trend Leveraged: "daily motivation” trend + consistency angle

Pro Tip: Use trending sounds like "Oh No" by Kreepa or "Espresso" by Sabrina Carpenter for hooks. Post between 7-9 PM EST for maximum engagement in the fitness niche.
```
